scope: One exposed Blocksworld p05 exact10000 development condition. Rotations are repeated timing observations, not independent cases/cycles. Matched integerthreadCPU andwall construction windows; sharedhost remains uncontrolled. Real transport and disk-exhaustion gaps occurred between arms; first six successful IDs preserved and remaining six resumed with unchanged native config/source. Those gaps and uncontrolled host conditions limit causal interpretation, no superiority or individualpredicate intrinsiccost inference. Every successful cost24 plan independently VAL valid. Exact final graphs qualified per mode, not every timing step. Zero counts durations mean disabled measurement. Conditional branch and common audit-hook argument cost retained.
interpretation: Report complete CPU andwall ranges including any reversals; CPU does not remove CPUfrequency/cache/contention or observer/bookkeeping overhead. Do not subtract aggregate clock overhead from individual predicate times or infer a new algorithm. One scored rotation is insufficient alone; all3 retained; Do not subtract aggregate CPUcontrast from wall individualcomponent timers. Evaluate remaining uncertainty and fullplanner/development scope before any optimization investment. Longer construction still has reversed fine/counts and counts/coarse CPU ratios; increasing max_states alone has not established a stable clock overhead estimate. Do not keep expanding this same timing grid as though it certified intrinsic predicate costs.
